g.text: Dynamic view — recall investigation, from authorised query to evidence export
Phase 1 · Authorise and fix the query scope
Phase 2 · Trace and verify recorded evidence
Preserve competing claims. Keep confirmed and
provisional impacts distinct. Missing proof, stale data
or a traversal limit is reported as incomplete/degraded;
it never implies that no affected lot exists.
Investigators can independently check exported proofs against public-chain commitments.
Recall queries use local materialisations; backup/chain calls are not on the synchronous read path.
Formal notices, private-document exchange and physical recall execution use existing external processes.
